spinner: A braille spinner cell, eight dots in two columns of four: a lit dot ticks round the edge and the dot it left decays behind it like phosphor.
skeleton: Rows of dim character cells printed cell by cell, held, and printed again: the sweep, one of the two loops the theme allows.
switch: A bracketed cell [█   ]: the block cursor steps across it in four character moves, dim at the left when off and lit at the right when on.
check: Text controls, the brackets of a curses form: [ ] and [x], ( ) and (*), still native inputs with the label as part of the target.
toast: Printed, not animated in: a > prompt, then the line typed out left to right in character steps.
dialog: A curses window framed with a double rule like box-drawing characters, its title lit with the bloom, drawn row by row from the top.
tooltip: Reverse video, the way a terminal highlights anything: near-black characters on green, like a pager's status line, typed in from the left.
steps: Bracketed numbers joined by > separators; finished steps print [x] and the current step is shown in reverse video.
empty: An empty prompt: > before the title and a block cursor after it that blinks five times and then stays lit.
link: The dashed underline a terminal draws under a hyperlink it knows about; under the pointer the link turns to reverse video.
